# Release finishing evidence

The recordings were freshly captured from the optimized release CLI build with default features,
not reconstructed from historical release output. See `results.json` for the
binary version, binary/source SHA-256 digests, exact arguments, exit codes and
per-stream hashes. The source digest covers sorted crate Rust sources, manifests
and Cargo.lock (relative path, NUL, then bytes). No credentials are captured.

`recordings.zip` contains raw `.ansi`, asciinema v2 `.cast`, and the two batch
HTML exports. A temporary directory in recorded commands denotes an ephemeral
input/output path. The watch capture changes valid JSON, introduces malformed
JSON, then recovers, before deliberate SIGINT (exit -2).

Reproduce from the repository root:

```bash
cargo build --release -p rs-rich-cli --locked --locked
python -m pip install -r scripts/requirements-docs-media.txt
python scripts/capture_release_demos.py
```

FFmpeg, Cairo and DejaVu Sans/Mono fonts must be installed. The capture
script uses Linux font paths and a POSIX PTY. Still-image frames are held for two seconds; watch is replayed at 10 fps
using recorded event timestamps. Captions and font rendering are added during
encoding; no output text is invented. No audio is present.

The alpha input is a deterministic RGBA fixture generated by the script. Other
art uses the repository's existing cat GIF, decoded as a still image by `rich image`.

Validation: 518 workspace tests, all-feature Clippy, MSRV 1.90 all-target/features,
lean CLI tests, three PTY watch regressions, six stable workflow snapshots, strict
MkDocs build and MP4 decode checks passed during preparation. CI remains required.

Responsive badge layout was checked in headless Chromium at 320, 390, 768 and
1440 CSS-pixel widths: all six badges loaded at 20px height, shared rows and
caused no horizontal overflow. Phone and desktop screenshots are included.
Remote badge SVGs were cached from their real GitHub image-proxy URLs for
the browser check; external web fonts were blocked, so system fallback fonts
are visible. No badge labels or status values were fabricated.
